name: Deployment, Rollout & Rollback
description: Deployment, Rollout & Rollback standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-DEPLOY applies.

rules.title: Produce immutable versioned artifacts
rules.detail: Build once and promote the same identifiable artifact across environments; do not rebuild production from a moving branch.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Produce immutable versioned artifacts.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Produce immutable versioned artifacts.

rules.title: Automate pre-deployment quality gates
rules.detail: Required tests, security checks, configuration validation and migration readiness must pass before production rollout.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Automate pre-deployment quality gates.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Automate pre-deployment quality gates.

rules.title: Use progressive or controlled rollout for material risk
rules.detail: Choose rolling, blue/green, canary or phased mobile/store rollout according to failure impact and rollback capability.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use progressive or controlled rollout for material risk.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use progressive or controlled rollout for material risk.

rules.title: Define rollback and forward-fix before deployment
rules.detail: Know whether code, configuration and database changes can be safely rolled back together; breaking migrations require staged compatibility.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define rollback and forward-fix before deployment.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define rollback and forward-fix before deployment.

rules.title: Run post-deployment verification
rules.detail: Check health, key SLI/SLO signals and critical smoke flows and stop/rollback rollout on defined failure thresholds.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Run post-deployment verification.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Run post-deployment verification.

rules.title: Record deployment evidence
rules.detail: Capture artifact/version, source revision, approver/actor, environment, migration/config changes and result.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Record deployment evidence.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Record deployment evidence.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-DEPLOY applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Deployment, Rollout & Rollback to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Deployment, Rollout & Rollback is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Deployment, Rollout & Rollback failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
